items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions talking to George Wein (Weaver?), but the interviewee (Jimmy McPartland) does not respond with any personal connection or confirmation of knowing Weaver.

ctx.x: And I just found out today, I was talking to George Wein (Weaver?).....
That's not really the question I meant to ask you, (LAUGHTER) I realised I repeated, I meant to ask you who was going to be there with you? But anyway, what did you find out today?
